motions.name: wedding
motions.line: What is this, a ring?<>Is this not a symbol of affection? <>Despite being unable to fully comprehend, I can't help but feel the urge to accept it... Is there something wrong with my neural cloud?<>Well, once I take it, it'll be mine, and I'm not ever giving it back. I'll get back to you when I figure out where the error is.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: I'm looking for some iridium, rhodium, or perhaps rhenium. You gave me something precious, so I'll return the favor by forging you a ring of rare metal. I don't mean anything else, it's but a courtesy.
